chunks: "Four things from perfume are disliked for the muhrim: musk, ambergris, saffron, and wars. And he used to dislike, among oils, those with a pleasant fragrance."

key_terms.الْوَرْسُ: wars, a yellow fragrant plant dye
key_terms.لِلْمُحْرِمِ: for the person in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: What types of fragrance are disliked for a muhrim in ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the muhrim during hajj or 'umrah, identifying four scented substances that are disliked for use. It also extends this dislike to fragrant oils, showing the general restriction on perfume-related items in the state of ihram.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2661 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Four types of fragrances are disliked for a Muhrim: musk, ambergris, saffron, and turmeric. He also disliked fragrant oils with a strong scent."
